title: Wuthering Waves

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · KURO GAMES build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Wuthering Waves as a free-to-play live-service action RPG digital holding.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from curated portrait key art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and KURO GAMES online services.
preservation.concerns: Free-to-play live-service structure creates high preservation risk: always-online dependency, seasonal content rotation, and possible retirement of services. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Mobile and other platform launches preceded the Steam PC listing. Steam storefront date for this edition is April 28, 2025. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody under the Steam distribution path.
preservation.availability: Held as a permanent digital license on the archive Steam account while that custody and the required online services continue.
